faq.question: Is Computer Science Engineering available in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Mauritius offers related degrees, including BSc Computer Science, Software Engineering and Applied Computing. The exact programme title may differ from “Computer Science Engineering,” so review the curriculum and qualification awarded. Students exploring Computer Science Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students should compare the available related degrees carefully.

faq.question: How long does a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science take?
faq.answer: The University of Mauritius lists its BSc (Hons) Computer Science as a three-year, full-time programme. The Open University of Mauritius lists a flexible duration of three to six years for its BSc (Hons) Computer Science.

faq.question: Which master’s programmes are related to Computer Science in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Relevant options include MSc Artificial Intelligence and MSc Software Project Management at the University of Mauritius, as well as MSc Applied Computing and Digital Technologies at the Open University of Mauritius.

faq.question: What is the approximate living cost for an international student?
faq.answer: A preliminary budget is MUR 15,000–25,000 per month, or approximately ₹30,000–₹50,000 using the illustrative exchange rate in this article. Actual expenses depend on accommodation and lifestyle.

faq.question: What jobs can I pursue after graduation?
faq.answer: Depending on your specialisation and experience, you could explore software development, data analysis, cybersecurity, cloud computing, AI, IT consulting or software project coordination. Practical projects and internships can strengthen your job applications.
